ValidationRule.description: Multiple products on Opp, Pricing Ticket Link is required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", RecordType.Name != 'Bank-PSP Partner', RecordType.Name != 'Strategic Partner', RecordType.Name != 'Agents', NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Renewal")), ofProducts__c > 1, ISBLANK(Pricing_Ticket_Link__c), DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > DATEVALUE("2022-06-30"), Probability >0.95 ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Must have a Jira Pricing Ticket Linked to Close Won this Opp. Refer to your Vertical Lead or Pricing Team with questions.
